candidates.name: Richard Dennis / William Eckhardt — original Turtle rules
candidates.era: 1983–1984 teaching rules, disclosed by participant Curtis Faith in 2003; later Turtle methods explicitly separate

normative.entry: System 1: one-tick 20-day high/low breakout, skip following a winning hypothetical prior breakout; 55-day failsafe. System 2: every one-tick 55-day breakout. Intraday signals, not close-only.
normative.exit: System 1 opposite 10-day extreme; System 2 opposite 20-day extreme; standard 2N stop. Optional Whipsaw stop is a separate variant, not silently merged.
normative.sizing: N uses 20-day smoothed true range; a 1N move per unit corresponds to 1% notional equity. Standard 2N initial stop therefore exposes about 2% per first unit before gap/slippage. Add units each 0.5N using executed prior fill, up to four.
normative.portfolio: Futures across currencies, rates and commodities. Limits: 4 units per market, 6 tightly correlated, 10 loosely correlated, 12 per direction. System 1/2 allocations were discretionary.
normative.risk: Stops tracked without displaying actual stop orders in original trading practice; notional equity reduced 20% after each 10% loss. Correlation classification and gap fills need explicit source reconciliation.

candidates.reproducibility_scope: HIGH for disclosed 1980s normative rules within declared variants; not Dennis entire career, later Turtle evolution, current VU engine or stock-only transfer.

candidates.name: Richard Dennis / William Eckhardt — original Turtle rules
candidates.era: 1983–1984 teaching rules, disclosed by participant Curtis Faith in 2003; later Turtle methods explicitly separate

normative.entry: System 1: one-tick 20-day high/low breakout, skip following a winning hypothetical prior breakout; 55-day failsafe. System 2: every one-tick 55-day breakout. Intraday signals, not close-only.
normative.exit: System 1 opposite 10-day extreme; System 2 opposite 20-day extreme; standard 2N stop. Optional Whipsaw stop is a separate variant, not silently merged.
normative.sizing: N uses 20-day smoothed true range; a 1N move per unit corresponds to 1% notional equity. Standard 2N initial stop therefore exposes about 2% per first unit before gap/slippage. Add units each 0.5N using executed prior fill, up to four.
normative.portfolio: Futures across currencies, rates and commodities. Limits: 4 units per market, 6 tightly correlated, 10 loosely correlated, 12 per direction. System 1/2 allocations were discretionary.
normative.risk: Stops tracked without displaying actual stop orders in original trading practice; notional equity reduced 20% after each 10% loss. Correlation classification and gap fills need explicit source reconciliation.

candidates.reproducibility_scope: HIGH for disclosed 1980s normative rules within declared variants; not Dennis entire career, later Turtle evolution, current VU engine or stock-only transfer.

normative.risk: Avoid loss averaging and overlarge orders in narrower markets; fixed 6-point historical rules scoped to active stocks around $30+, explicitly says low-price formula must change.
